text:
Maria Chen: OK team — kicking off design partner acquisition for Q3. Goal: 8–12 engaged DP customers, 6-week feedback windows, and a clear launch/rollback checklist. I sketched a timeline: week 0 outreach, week 1 onboarding + SDK install, weeks 2–5 active feedback (weekly syncs), week 6 acceptance. Link to draft doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/dp-q3 (please don’t share externally).

Devon Patel: Nice. Quick Q on incentives — are we doing credits, co-marketing, or both?

Maria Chen: Thinking $5k credit + case study ask for full partners, lighter credits ($500) for pilots. Co-marketing for 3 anchor partners. Open to feedback.

Samir Gupta: For scope negotiation: we should have Must-Have vs Stretch list per partner. Must-Have = metrics hooks (latency/cost), prompt set replication, basic safety filters. Stretch = offline quantization experiments, private deployment tests.

Elena Ortiz: Agree. Also need a simple acceptance test: 5 live sessions with partner PM, <2% major-quality-regression, and no P0 infra incidents for 72 hours after rollout. Add to checklist.

Ash K.: Ops question — who owns the onboarding runbook? I can take the SDK + infra checklist, but need an owner for legal/KIAs (data retention, KMS).

Maria Chen: Ash owns runbook. Elena will own acceptance tests. Devon/Marketing will own outreach and co-marketing asks. Samir will handle instrumentation requirements.

Devon Patel: Outreach copy draft: "We’re inviting a small number of partners to shape Redwood’s private & dedicated onramp. 6-week engagement, engineering support, and credits offered. We’re looking for product teams who need predictable latency and control over data." Feedback?

Elena Ortiz: Love it — add an explicit ask for a primary technical contact and a weekly 30m sync. Also include expected time commitments up front.

Samir Gupta: Instrumentation: need these signals in first 2 weeks — per-route latency p50/p95, token cost per request, KV cache hit rate, and error types. I’ll drop a telemetry spec into the doc.

Maria Chen: Decision point: do we require NDA before onboarding? My vote: yes for private partners; optional for public pilots. Thoughts?

Ash K.: Legal prefers NDAs for any partner testing private deployment or sensitive data. For hosted pilots, opt-in data agreement with anonymized telemetry is fine.

Devon Patel: Incentive detail: propose a small milestone payment tied to acceptance (e.g., 20% on acceptance, remainder on case study). Less bookkeeping for pilots if we do credits only.

Maria Chen: Risk/rollback: plan to fallback to hosted model if private deployment exceeds SLA or partner opts to pause. Define a capacity fallback: we should have a 'compatible model variant' tested and ready. Samir, can you list compatible models?

Samir Gupta: Will do. Quick note: we should pre-approve a list of 3 model variants (quantized/dense/low-latency) and smoke them in our staging infra before partner onboarding.

Elena Ortiz: Success metrics (proposal): time-to-value (first successful prod call) <14 days, weekly active integration sessions >=75% attendance, partner satisfaction >=8/10 in final survey, and 10% improvement in token cost or latency for at least 50% of partners.

Maria Chen: Sounds good. Action items: 1) Devon: finalize outreach email and partner list by Tue (1709880000). 2) Ash: publish onboarding runbook + legal checklist by Thu (1709950000). 3) Samir: telemetry + model variant list by Fri (1709960000). 4) Elena: acceptance test template and survey by next Mon (1709990000).

pm-bot: Reminder set: DP outreach deadline Tue 1709880000.

Devon Patel: FYI — reached out to two potential anchors (FinSense, ReplyHealth). Both interested in early Jan timeline but open to Q3 with credits.

Maria Chen: Great. One negotiation note: some partners want model control (ability to pin model weights). We should prepare a policy doc: what we can guarantee (version pinning, rollback windows, throughput tiers).

Samir Gupta: Also flagging infra constraints — private on-prem installs may need 2–4 week lead time for HSM/KMS certs. Add to dependency list.

Elena Ortiz: Can we schedule a 30m sync Thursday to finalize outreach list + incentives?

Maria Chen: Yes — Thurs 11am in #product. Agenda: final list, incentive types, acceptance test sign-off.

Ash K.: I’ll bring runbook draft.

Devon Patel: I’ll bring outreach copy + potential partner pitches.

Samir Gupta: I’ll bring telemetry + model variant notes.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to incentives or acceptance criteria, flag here before Thu EOD.

Elena Ortiz: No objections from me. :)

Samir Gupta: All good.

Devon Patel: ack

Maria Chen: closing the loop — adding a small note to the doc about data retention (30 days telemetry by default, extendable on request). We’ll iterate. Thanks!
